design_context: B2B SaaS Admin Dashboard (Linear / Vercel Aesthetic)

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for cards. Rely on 1px borders for structure and depth.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-md (6px) for standard UI elements like buttons, inputs, and cards.

components.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md shadow-sm p-6
components.sidebar: w-64 bg-[#F9FAFB] border-r border-slate-200 flex flex-col h-full flex-shrink-0
components.sidebar_item: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:text-[#0A1128] hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors
components.sidebar_item_active: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 transition-colors
components.table_header: bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 font-medium border-y border-slate-200 px-4 py-3
components.table_row: border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition-colors text-slate-700 px-4 py-3
components.button_primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-1
components.button_secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-[#0A1128] rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
components.badge_demo: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-700 tracking-wide uppercase
components.input: flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-blue-500

grids.dashboard_stats: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

layouts.main_structure: flex h-screen w-full overflow-hidden bg-white text-[#0A1128]
layouts.content_area: flex-1 flex flex-col h-screen overflow-y-auto bg-white
layouts.header: sticky top-0 z-10 flex h-14 items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 bg-white px-6
layouts.page_container: p-6 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full flex-1 space-y-6

motion.general: No bouncy animations. Keep transitions strictly functional and professional.

accessibility.screen_readers: Ensure all icon buttons have aria-labels.

media.icons: lucide-react. Keep sizing at 16px-18px for sidebar and buttons. 1.5 stroke width.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React and Tailwind CSS in .js files.
Ensure all UI copy is in Turkish: 'Genel Bakış', 'Ürünler', 'İçe Aktar', 'Toplu İşlemler', 'Dışa Aktar', 'Ayarlar'.
Display a 'Demo Modu' badge in the header if no API key is provided.

Implement the Dashboard (stats and activity), Product Import (CSV/XML upload with column mapping), Product Catalog (searchable/filterable table), Product Editor (side-by-side original/improved), Bulk Editing, and Export features.
Sidebar should be fixed on the left and desktop-first responsive.
Use Shadcn UI logic where applicable, but override styling to match this strict B2B SaaS aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs or templated designs.
Never use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through 1px borders and very subtle shadows, not heavy drop shadows.
Do not apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific interactive elements.
Do not center align the app container. Keep it strict left-aligned for data density.
Use pill-shaped or rounded-md buttons with clear focus states.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='import-submit-button').
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, dropdowns, or any surface with content underneath.
